verdict.rationale: Bolna's Workflows feature runs multi-step outreach sequences that chain voice agent calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries. These run unattended in the background via the API (bolna-docs-12). Batch calling (bolna-docs-24) and per-call webhooks and extractions that push data to a CRM (bolna-docs-32) add automatic follow-through. missing for 10: detailed docs on triggers, scheduling and monitoring of workflows, a no-code workflow builder (workflows are API-only), and independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows run reliably on their own.
